descriptions.text: New Quest. The Chowder War. Oh, you're getting involved whether you like it or not. The Monk Seals. The Red Maníseros Land Crabs. War is brewing, as it often does in these parts. Every season, the land crabs emerge from their forests to attend their sex parties in the oceans surrounding these lands. The Monk Seals hold the ocean sacred, and the very act of spilling so much crab chowder into their holy waters is considered a sacrilege most foul... Choose a side. Put an end to this conflict, one way or another. Reward: You will receive a Platinum Quest Box.

recap.text: The party hunts monk seals and takes a quest to settle a conflict between two populations for a platinum box. Carl and Donut flag crabs during a sneak attack, while Sister Ines warns the Monk Seal Abbot. Samantha finds Sister Ines on a giant snake with zombie pups, and the quest fails. Hell Comes to Crawler Town begins as Sheol evicts demons into the dead. The Missing Piece quest updates to refill the world with crab souls.

beats.headline: Out hunting monk seals, home with a war
beats.text: The party goes looking for monk seals to fill its squad slots and picks up the quest instead. Two populations, one coastline, one annual event that neither side can negotiate around, and a platinum box waiting for whoever settles it.
beats.gist: The party hunts monk seals to fill squad slots and picks up a quest for a platinum box.

beats.headline: The crabs go early and go south
beats.text: The migration opens as a sneak attack. Rather than spread along the coast the crabs mass where the seals are thinnest and run for the water together. Carl and Donut go down to flag one of them.
beats.gist: Crabs mass where seals are thinnest and run for the water; Carl and Donut flag one.

beats.headline: Sister Ines takes the other side
beats.text: She reaches an agreement with the Monk Seal Abbot and warns him what the crabs are doing. That turns a slaughter into a battle, and puts two crawlers at opposite ends of the same quest.
beats.gist: Sister Ines warns the Monk Seal Abbot about the crabs, turning a slaughter into a battle.

beats.headline: Failed, and something worse announced
beats.text: Samantha scouts ahead and finds Sister Ines on a giant snake, with zombie pups crawling over it, and living seals singing and living crabs dancing around it. The quest fails. Hell Comes to Crawler Town is announced in its place, and so much death reaches the underworld that Sheol overflows and starts evicting its demons upward into the weakened and the freshly dead.
beats.gist: Samantha finds Sister Ines on a giant snake with zombie pups, singing seals, and dancing crabs.

beats.headline: The same flavour of chowder
beats.text: The Missing Piece quest updates mid-battle: the eviction that brought Amayon here is his undoing: now in his true form, he lacks the power to cast his spell home, and the dying world has too few souls left to trigger it. The fix it hints at is to refill the world with the same type of souls that set the whole thing off. The same flavour of chowder, it says. The announcers had it that the eviction began because the AI counted crab sperm as a mob, so the answer is a crab, a beach full of corpses, and the eggs still out in the water.
beats.gist: The Missing Piece quest updates; Amayon lacks the power to cast his spell home.
